feeds.title: Noirsville - the film noir
feeds.description: It's Noirsville, a visually oriented blog celebrating the vast and varied sources of inspiration, all of the resulting output, and all of the creative reflections back, of a particular style/tool of film making used in certain film/plot sequences or for the entirety of the film that conveyed claustrophobia, alienation, obsession, and events spiraling out of control, that came to fruition in the roughly the period of the last two and a half decades of B&W film.

feeds.title: Classic Movie Hub Blog » Noir Nook
feeds.description: Discover your favorite Noir films, stars, trivia, quotes, articles, charts, and more! Classic Movie Hub Blog is a blog dedicated to the era of classics from the 1900s.

feeds.title: Film Noir Board
feeds.description: A blog by Eric Somer devoted to the classic American film noirs of the 1940s and 1950s.

feeds.title: International Noir Fiction
feeds.description: International Noir Fiction includes reviews and ideas on crime novels (mostly from outside the U.S.).

feeds.title: The Losers of Film Noir
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with The Losers of Film Noir substack blog by Carol Saint Martin. Relive and enjoy engaging discussions, thoughts, and opinions on some golden movies, characters, and stories from the Noir genre. Carol is a screenwriter, playwright, and full-time blogger.

feeds.title: Nordic Noir
feeds.description: We are an academically based fan discussion group in Scotland. Have a look at what we're assembling here and use it to share enthusiasm for what's become known as the 'Nordic Noir' brand of TV drama and genre fiction.

feeds.title: Noir Girl
feeds.description: The title 'NoirGirl' is an homage to the collection of films made in Hollywood in the 1940s and '50s that came to be known as 'film noir.' They are characterized by double-crossing dames, detectives wearing fedoras and long trench coats, and lots of shadows that are used to their full advantage on the black and white film.
